name: Get channel
description: GET /2026-07/channel. Cursor page: optional RecordsPerPage (default 50) and Cursor. Response is { items, next, prev }; next/prev are URLs such as /2026-07/channel?cursor=... . Connection probe reads the first page only.

RecordsPerPage.description: Page size. ShipBob default is 50 when omitted.

Cursor.description: Cursor query value taken from the next or prev URL (query param cursor). Not the URL itself.
